_comment: Static reference for the exact command used to produce ml/checkpoints/sugarshield-v1. The authoritative, machine-generated record of what actually ran (including measured loss/duration) is ml/results/training_run.json, written by train.py itself at the end of the run.
base_model: none (trained from scratch — see ml/README.md for why LoRA on a pretrained checkpoint was not possible in this environment)
architecture: GPT-2 style causal LM (transformers.GPT2LMHeadModel, randomly initialized)
tokenizer: custom byte-level BPE, trained on the SugarShield prompt+target corpus by ml/prepare_dataset.py
lr_schedule: linear warmup + decay (transformers default), warmup_steps = max(5, steps_per_epoch // 4)
fine_tuning_method: full_parameter_from_scratch (not LoRA/QLoRA — no pretrained base was reachable; train.py supports --use_lora --base_model <id> for environments where one is)
